notes: Live curves are descriptive, not independent scientific replications.
Generational scores reset each cohort; continuous scores average all recorded lifetimes.
Predator/prey scores remain separate; social fitness is survival age.
Founder labels are genealogy, not species. Random/greedy placeholder weights have no diversity score.
Genomes are birth parameters; configuration plus tick/control replay reproduces this run, not an arbitrary resume checkpoint.
Commanded speed retains the original telemetry meaning; habitat telemetry metres records actual travel.
V2 PHYSICAL HABITAT: changed movement/metabolism/food placement. Use v2 habitat replay, not the original simulator replay. Not comparable to legacy runs without matched habitat settings.
